def analyze_table(db_url: str, table_name: str) -%C2%BB None:
    engine = create_engine(db_url)
    df = pd.read_sql_table(table_name, engine)
    engine.dispose()

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print(f"  DATABASE SUMMARY - Table: '{table_name}'")
    print(f"  Rows: {len(df)} | Columns: {list(df.columns)}")
    print("=" * 60)

    numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include="number").columns.tolist()
    if numeric_cols:
        print("\n📊 NUMERIC AGGREGATES")
        print("-" * 40)
        summary = df[numeric_cols].agg(["mean","sum","min","max","count"])
        summary.index = ["Mean","Sum","Min","Max","Count"]
        print(summary.round(2).to_string())

    cat_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=["object","category"]).columns.tolist()
    if cat_cols:
        print("\n📂 CATEGORY COUNTS")
        print("-" * 40)
        for col in cat_cols:
            print(f"\n  Column: '{col}'")
            vc = df[col].value_counts()
            for val, count in vc.items():
                pct = 100 * count / len(df)
                bar = "█" * int(pct / 2)
                print(f"    {str(val):%C2%AB10} {count:%C2%BB4}  ({pct:5.1f}%)  {bar}")

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("  FULL SUMMARY TABLE")
    print("=" * 60)
    rows = []
    for col in df.columns:
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[col]):
            rows.append({"column": col, "type": "numeric",
                         "mean": round(df[col].mean(),2),
                         "sum": round(df[col].sum(),2),
                         "categories": "-"})
        else:
            rows.append({"column": col, "type": "categorical",
                         "mean": "-", "sum": "-",
                         "categories": df[col].nunique()})
    summary_df = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("column")
    print(summary_df.to_string())
    print("\n✅ Analysis complete.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
